verdict.rationale: AvaTax claims tax rates and rules for 200+ countries, and Avalara documents a separate VAT Reporting product for preparing and submitting VAT returns across jurisdictions. Nexus declarations support tracking where the company must collect and remit. However, nothing in the evidence names EU OSS/IOSS, UK, Canada, Australia or GST, and no evidence shows automated tracking of foreign registration thresholds. A community comment says registration and filing still need separate handling, but it is generic and does not concretely contradict the VAT Reporting docs. missing for 10: explicit EU OSS/IOSS support, named UK/Canada/Australia GST coverage, foreign registration-threshold tracking, evidence that filing is part of AvaTax rather than a separate product, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder selling internationally, VAT and GST are covered like US sales tax — EU OSS/IOSS, UK, Canada, Australia and beyond, with foreign registration thresholds tracked and filings supported

citations.quote: Global coverage. Access tax rates and rules for 200+ countries and jurisdictions
VAT Reporting helps businesses manage the preparation and submission of value-added tax (VAT) obligations across jurisdictions.
The concept of Nexus indicates a place where your company is legally obligated to collect and remit transactional taxes.
